home.use_title: What can you make with a CNC router?
home.use_desc: CNC routers are an essential part of modern manufacturing. Thanks to excellent precision (±0.01 mm) and material versatility, a CNC router can process wood, plywood, MDF, acrylic, aluminum and much more. Our clients in Latvia are already successfully using Wattsan machines for the following applications:
home.use1: Furniture manufacturing: doors, frames, handles, stairs, kitchen fronts and interior elements
home.use2: Advertising industry: logos, signs, 3D letters, LED boxes and decorative panels
home.use3: Souvenirs and gifts: engraved plaques, toys, personalized products
home.use4: Technical parts: gaskets, organizers, inserts, mechanism components
home.use5: Construction: stair treads, railings, decorative facade elements
home.guide_title: How to choose the right CNC router?
home.guide_desc: Based on our 20+ years of equipment consulting experience, we recommend answering these two key questions before purchasing:
home.guide_q1_title: What products will I manufacture and from what materials?
home.guide_q1_text: The material type (wood, MDF, plywood, acrylic, aluminum) determines the required spindle power and tools. For example, aluminum processing requires a more powerful spindle and cooling system.
home.guide_q2_title: What is the planned production volume and required speed?
home.guide_q2_text: For hobbies and small orders, the A1 series will suffice. For professional production with heavy workloads, we recommend the M1 or M3 series — they are designed for 8-12 hours of daily operation.
home.guide_example: For example, for door manufacturing, the 1325 series models are ideal (1300×2500 mm work area), which match standard door blanks. For hobbies and small souvenirs, compact models like the 0404 Mini are more than sufficient — despite their size, they are equipped with powerful spindles.

home.faq_sub: Answers to the most frequently asked questions about purchasing and operating Wattsan CNC routers in Latvia.
home.faq1_q: Which CNC router should a beginner choose?
home.faq1_a: For beginners, we recommend the Wattsan 0404 MINI or 0609 MINI models — they are compact, easy to use and equipped with an intuitive control system. These models are ideal for hobbies, educational purposes and small-scale product manufacturing. After mastering the basics, you can easily transition to larger models.
home.faq2_q: Do you provide CNC router delivery throughout Latvia?
home.faq2_a: Yes, SIA Bratus provides free delivery throughout Latvia for all Wattsan CNC routers. We also offer professional installation, staff training and technical support. Delivery time is typically 5–15 business days depending on model availability.
home.faq3_q: What is the warranty on Wattsan CNC routers?
home.faq3_a: All Wattsan CNC routers come with the official manufacturer's warranty of 24 months. As the official Wattsan representative in Latvia, we provide full on-site warranty service — repairs, spare parts supply and technical diagnostics. Spare parts are always available in our warehouse.
home.faq4_q: Is a CNC router suitable for my business?
home.faq4_a: A CNC router is suitable for a wide range of business applications — furniture manufacturing, door and stair production, advertising element manufacturing, souvenir and decor making. Our team will help you choose the model best suited to your needs and budget. We offer free consultation and the opportunity to see the machines in person.
